name: Layout and composition
summary: Place things on a vertical 9:16 card: grid, thirds, safe zones, type hierarchy, text that fits its box, and colours that stay legible.
qualityBar: 12-column grid spans exactly x 72 to 1008; tiles are equal, never overlap and fill their box
fitPx fits 12 real headlines in 776 px and at most 3 lines at 42 px or more, balances lines, and answers fits:false for copy that cannot fit
autoLayout keeps hierarchy (head over sub at least 1.25x), stays in its box, stays left of x 940 in the rail band, and its drawn ink sits inside the computed box
layoutIssues and composeCheck each catch the failure they claim (top, bottom, rail, 42 px, overlap, flat hierarchy, off-balance)
contrastRatio matches WCAG (white on black 21); ensureContrast lifts the dim grey to 4.5:1 and darkens on light grounds
Demo: engine QC passes on the card and on the mp4 (safe zones, 42 px floor, no frozen frames, closer present)
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size 1080x1920 (70 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, silent; engine QC on the card and on the mp4 passed). I viewed out/contact.png twice and judged the final one good (guides and tiles, re-fit between 104 px and a smaller headline, contrast rows with the auto-fix). Fixed during the run: outBack(0) returns 2e-16 not 0, so a scaled chip was drawn at 0 px and failed the 42 px rule (now guarded); contrast page rows enlarged; page 3 no longer overlaps page 2's exit. NOT checked: motion judged from stills and motion-energy numbers, never played back by a person; layouts with more than 4 blocks or with right-to-left text; autoLayout with a centre far from x 540 beyond one unit test; the 12-column grid is used in tests and the tile grid in the demo, but no card in this tier is built on the column spans yet.
